description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called CostUsageHistoryMenuView that displays cost usage history, including a header with total costs, a bar chart visualization, and a footer indicating missing data entries. It also includes a helper enum for date parsing and formatting.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Constructs the header view showing today's cost and total cost over a specified number of days.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: Builds a bar chart visualization of daily cost data over time.

methods.name: footer
methods.description: Displays a message if there are missing cost entries.
